title: iberis amara subsp. forestieri
intro: Iberis amara subsp. forestieri, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in its ability to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Iberis amara subsp. forestieri include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its therapeutic actions.
